description: A dramatic outdoor tropical terrace or pergola setting photographed at golden-hour dusk. A string of small round filament globes is strung in gentle catenary curves across the background between the palms, their warm amber glow beginning to activate as the sky darkens. The mood is romantic, tropical-resort luxe, and celebratory — the kind of scene set for an outdoor dining event or destination wedding under the palms at sunset. Camera is at a low eye-level looking upward at a pronounced pitch toward the ceiling of the pergola, framing the central overhead source against the tropical sky and palm canopy, a wide-establishing composition that emphasizes the drama of the setting.
